title: Zeus Arc GT4 Care Package
description:
The Zeus Arc Care Package GT4 is the easiest and most convenient way to inject new life into your Zeus Arc GT series.

The Zeus Arc Care Package comes bundled with a complete set of parts and accessories to keep your Zeus Arc GT series vaporizer in top performing condition.

Compatible with Zeus GT series including GTS

The Zeus Arc Care Package Contains:
1 x Mouthpiece w/ GTS Button
1 x GT Screen
1 x GT Flow Sink
2 x GT Flow Sink Screen
